svg.text: SX-70 External Power Pack — Option B, carrier PCB
Net labels connect blocks. Pogo pins are the only output; the pack is for i-Type film.
B−, midpoint, B+ — midpoint also feeds U2 BM
USB-C is on the module. VIN+ is tapped for the interlock.
FB divider sets 5.99 V against the 0.8 V reference
EN high only when SW1 is on AND no USB present. SW1 is in series with R6 so
switching off also removes the 9.3 µA divider draw. R6/R7 double as a ~6.4 V soft LVC.
C1 before D1/R1 so surge current still passes through R1.
D1 blocks film → pack. F1 ends a sustained pack → film fault.
R1 budget = target minus pogo pins (40 mΩ) minus F1 hold resistance.
NOT ON THE BOARD: BT1, U1 and the USB-C connector (on the U2 module).
NO output connector — J1 was dropped; the pogo pins are the output.
U2 pads LED and NTC are unused. U3 PG and FB2 left open.
